# Ashmit Samanta

CSE student and Full-Stack Developer building web applications, document verification systems, and fraud-detection layers with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Python, and React.js.

## Projects

- [Veri-byte](https://github.com/ashmitsamanta/Veri-Byte-Web-Page.git): An AI-assisted identity and document verification platform, built with React, Vite, and a FastAPI backend with Supabase.
- [CyberScope](https://github.com/ashmitsamanta/CyberScope.git): An explainable fraud intelligence platform that links messages, phone numbers, URLs, payment identifiers, and bank accounts into a single fraud graph.
